items.item_text: Education level necessary to obtain required licensure and certifications
CPT-1 certification required and CPR (BLS-AHA)
CA Phlebotomy Technician I (CPT-1) License
CA Phleobotomy Technician II (CPT-2) License
One year of acute care hospital experience in phlebotomy, CPT-2 (ABG)
Ensures that safe laboratory practices, universal precautions and observance of OSHA and HIPAA regulations are used at all times.
Responsible for familiarity with MSDS guidelines and State of California regulations in relation to the laboratory.
Responsible for maintaining basic job standards for all Dignity Health- Central California positions by participating in all mandatory training sessions or work shops.
Evaluates the appropriate information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his/her age-specific needs.
Responsible for maintaining the phlebotomy skills necessary to provide care for patients ranging from neonates to geriatrics.
Once certified -responsible for the collection of arterial blood for the purpose of blood gas analysis only. Is directly accountable to the Medical Laboratory Director for this procedure.

Receives and processes specimens within established timelines. Evaluates specimens based on established guidelines for specimen appropriateness for tests ordered, specimen quality and specimen volume for number of test ordered.
Reviews orders for reference lab testing for specimen type and specimen handling instructions. Appropriately batches and sends testing to appropriate testing facility or reference laboratory.
Correctly aliquots and prepares specimens for send out testing.
Prepares blood smears and body fluid smears for Wright Stain and Gram Stain testing for Clinical Laboratory Scientist review.
During computer downtime situations is responsible for printing labels or using "downtime labels" if necessary and posting draws in appropriate area for the Lab Assistant.
Basic laboratory bench practice skills
Working knowledge of medical terminology
General computer skills
Must demonstrate excellent communication and customer service skills
Must have the ability to read, write, and speak English
Ability to perform all phlebotomy functions including venous, capillary, and arterial punctures on adult, pediatric, and neonates populations
Ability to adapt to work load demands and remain calm and function efficiently during difficult or emergency situations
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
